subject: Requested adjustments to retention & backup purge timing (Cardea Health DPA)
messages:
From: Sarah Kendall <sarah.kendall@cardea-health.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardea-health.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Retention carve-in request + DPA redlines (attached)

Hi Marcus / Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — Cardea's security review flagged a couple of asks we need to resolve before procurement can sign. Two items in particular:

1) Backup purge timeline: our EU compliance team requires that snapshot backups and offsite backups containing Cardea data be retained for 24 months rather than your standard 12/18 months. We understand this is an exception request; please confirm whether Redwood can:
   - Extend backups for the eu-west-1 footprint to 24 months, and
   - Provide a documented runbook for purge execution and evidence (audit log) that a purge occurred.

2) Log retention exceptions: some PII-linked telemetry we need to keep for 24 months to support regulatory investigations. Can Redwood add a scoped exception for a named dataset/class to the DPA (we've flagged the relevant sections in the attached redlines).

I've attached Cardea_DPA_redlines_v3.docx and a short retention matrix showing the specific buckets we care about. Procurement has asked for any impact to pricing or SLA in writing.

Next steps we'd like: a short mutual-action plan and a target timeline for legal sign-off + procurement PO.

Thanks,
Sarah Kendall
Head of Compliance, Cardea Health
sarah.kendall@cardea-health.com
+44 20 5555 0123

Attachments: Cardea_DPA_redlines_v3.docx (docx), retention_matrix.csv (csv)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kendall <sarah.kendall@cardea-health.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, procurement@cardea-health.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention carve-in request + DPA redlines (attached)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear notes and the redlines. Appreciate the retention matrix, that helps.

Quick summary from our side and proposed MAP:

- Feasibility: Engineering (cc'ed Aditya) indicates we can provide a 24-month retention window for snapshot/offsite backups limited to the eu-west-1 region and scoped datasets. We'll need to scope which buckets/log types are in/out.
- Evidence & purge audits: we can provide an exported purge audit (timestamped job run + checksum of affected snapshots) and an ops-runbook excerpt showing purge steps.
- DPA changes: Legal (Kimberly) will review the redlines and propose language for a scoped retention carve-in with a defined sunset and emergency rollback process.
- Commercial impact: There will likely be a small incremental fee for extended offsite snapshot retention due to additional storage costs; I'll have finance provide a banded estimate once Kimberly confirms scope.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (short):
1) By Wed 2027-06-23: Redwood to provide scoped dataset list and preliminary cost band. (Marcus / Aditya)
2) By Thu 2027-06-24: Legal to propose DPA exhibit language and retention runbook sample. (Kimberly)
3) By Mon 2027-06-28: Procurement to issue PO & DocuSign for the amendment (Cardea).

If that timeline works for you we'll start the internal runbook prep now. Aditya — can you confirm any technical constraints for excluding non‑PII telemetry from long term backups (so we don't over-retain)?

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0989

> > Thanks for the demo last week — Cardea's security review flagged a couple of asks...
> > Attachments: Cardea_DPA_redlines_v3.docx, retention_matrix.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Kendall <sarah.kendall@cardea-health.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 08:29:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention carve-in request + DPA redlines (attached)

Hi all,

I've reviewed Sarah's redlines and conferred with Product/Infra. Major points and proposed legal/ops approach below — this is intentionally prescriptive so procurement can accept language quickly.

1) Scoped exception (legal): we'll add an Exhibit X to the DPA that:
   - Identifies Cardea Data Classes A/B (as indicated in your matrix) by name;
   - Limits the exception to eu-west-1 infrastructure;
   - Includes a required purge certification delivered within 10 business days of execution for any ad-hoc purge request.

2) Backup retention (ops): Redwood will maintain snapshot/offsite backups for the scoped Cardea buckets for 24 months. Purge scheduling will be batched quarterly; we will provide an ops purge manifest (job id, start/end time, objects deleted) and a signed certificate of destruction sample.

3) Logging granularity (tech): Aditya — we need confirmation on whether we can retain PII-linked telemetry in a logically separable store to avoid retaining all telemetry for 24 months. If not feasible, we need to define filters (e.g., by tag or prefix) so the retention can be narrow.

4) Commercials: Redwood proposes a one-time setup fee of USD 4,500 for retention policy changes + USD 0.012/GB/month for incremental storage on scoped backups. This is a placeholder pending precise dataset sizes; Marcus please confirm whether Cardea is ok to receive a cost estimate and a PO for the setup fee.

5) Subprocessors & transfers: We'll include a subprocessor addendum listing the EU storage subprocessor and indicate any cross-border transfers under the standard SCCs. If Cardea requires an on-prem escrow or third-party escrow of snapshots, that will be scoped separately.

Attached: retention_matrix.csv (ops annotated) — this includes suggested tags and prefixes to mark as long-retain.

If Cardea confirms the scoped list by EOD Fri (06/25) we can lock the language and circulate a DocuSign amendment template.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: retention_matrix.csv

From: Sarah Kendall <sarah.kendall@cardea-health.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cardea-health.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention carve-in request + DPA redlines (attached)

Kimberly / Marcus — thank you, this is exactly what we needed. Cardea confirms:

- Scoped list: we've signed the annotated retention_matrix and will send the final CSV by COB Fri 06/25.
- Commercials: procurement is OK to include the one-time setup fee in the PO; we will return a PO reference and expected signature date along with the final CSV.
- Evidence: the purge manifest sample is acceptable; please include an estimated SLA for delivery of purge certificates after a requested purge (Kimberly suggested 10 business days, which Cardea accepts).

Procurement note: we'll target DocuSign completion by Mon 2027-06-28 and will send the PO on that date. If Redwood can circulate the DocuSign amendment this week (even as a draft), that will speed things.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if you prefer to walk the commit live.

Best,
Sarah
